enrichment.headline: Pays HERTZ Environmental up to $21,500 for stormwater pollution plan work at Claremont Middle School
enrichment.summary: The district would pay HERTZ Environmental up to $21,500 for stormwater pollution prevention plan (SWPPP) consulting on the Claremont Middle School Multipurpose Room and Kitchen Project. The work includes preparing the plan, site inspections, reporting, training and permit monitoring, and the cap includes up to $3,000 for additional services. Work is scheduled from March 24, 2022 to October 31, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.title: General Services Agreement – HERTZ Environmental, Inc. – Claremont Middle School Multipurpose Room & Kitchen Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management
